ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels. High macro-level contrast dominated by a dark base with extensive white surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense white/high-intensity mottling and focal patches concentrated at the distal tips and along the outer margins of both lobes. Central longitudinal region and area adjacent to the peduncle exhibit contiguous low-intensity black pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregularly serrated boundary with high-frequency peaks and valleys. Notable high-amplitude (depth) indentations visible on the left lobe trailing edge and a significant notch/nick approximately one-third inward from the right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the upper distal margins transitioning into a sharp concave trajectory as the lobes descend toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of circular white high-contrast spots located on the far left distal tip, consistent with barnacle attachment sites. Smaller, isolated circular white spots are scattered across the mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crisscrossing the dark regions of both lobes; highest density observed on the mid-left lobe section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged excision/notch on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe and several deep secondary nicks along the trailing margin of the right lobe suggesting previous physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense, cross-hatched pattern of linear scratches on the mid-left lobe creates a unique high-frequency texture distinct from the broader mottling.
